A_raw_nwp.description: Baseline A -- raw NWP forecast, uncorrected

B_global_ml.description: Baseline B -- single global ML bias correction (regime-blind)

C_quantile_mapping.description: Baseline C -- global empirical quantile mapping (no ML)

C_regime_quantile_mapping.description: Ablation -- quantile mapping fitted per regime

E_regime_residual_probability.description: Model E -- regime-specific residual correction + calibrated heavy-rain probability

notes: Regime routing at test time uses the learned classifier, not the rule labeller, because the rules require the observation.
Regimes with their own correction model: ['Active', 'Break', 'Coastal', 'Depression-Low', 'Orographic']; all others routed to the global fallback.
Prediction intervals: nominal 80%, actual coverage 75.8% on the test set (mean width 10.3 mm).
Models D and E share the same corrected rainfall field, so their continuous and rainfall-categorical scores are identical by construction. E is distinguished only by the probabilistic scores.
